about: Prompts for the AI-generated sample songs. Every song here is made up for this project: the captions and lyrics are original, and no existing song, artist or recording is referenced. Give each entry to an AI music generator and save the result as clips/<name>.mp3 (30 seconds); see GENERATING_SONGS.md. Styles are tried in order against a song's genre name and the first match wins.

clips.name: classical-high
clips.lyrics: [Instrumental]
clips.caption: A lively orchestral allegro: bright strings carrying a quick dancing melody, woodwinds answering, timpani and brass at the peaks. Concert hall sound, joyful and grand.

clips.name: classical-low
clips.lyrics: [Instrumental]
clips.caption: A slow, tender solo piano adagio with soft sustained strings underneath. Intimate, reflective and calm, lots of space between the notes.

clips.name: jazz-high
clips.lyrics: [Instrumental]
clips.caption: Up-tempo big band swing: walking upright bass, ride cymbal, punchy brass section hits and a hot tenor saxophone solo. Exuberant dance hall energy.

clips.name: jazz-low
clips.lyrics: [Instrumental]
clips.caption: A late-night jazz trio ballad: brushed drums, warm upright bass and a gentle piano melody. Smoky, relaxed and unhurried.

clips.name: blues-high
clips.caption: A driving electric blues shuffle with a gritty male vocal, stinging lead guitar licks, harmonica and a pounding rhythm section. Roadhouse energy.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Woke up this morning, the coffee pot was dry
Woke up this morning, the coffee pot was dry
My old truck won't start and the rent is riding high

[Chorus]
But I got my six string and the band is on tonight

clips.name: blues-low
clips.caption: A slow, aching twelve-bar blues: weeping electric guitar, soft organ, a weary soulful male vocal. Late, dark and heartfelt.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Rain on the window, counting every drop
Rain on the window, counting every drop
The clock keeps on walking and my thinking will not stop

clips.name: reggae-high
clips.caption: Bouncy upbeat ska: choppy offbeat guitar, a bright horn section riff, walking bass and an energetic male vocal. Sunny and danceable.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Shoes by the door and the sun coming up
Everybody moving with a paper coffee cup

[Chorus]
Step it up, step it up, the morning is ours
Step it up, step it up, we got hours and hours

clips.name: reggae-low
clips.caption: Laid-back roots reggae with a one-drop drum beat, deep round bass, offbeat organ skank and a warm relaxed male vocal. Easy and sunny.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Slow down the river, slow down the day
Let the little worries float on away

[Chorus]
Easy now, easy, under the tree
Easy now, easy, come sit with me

clips.name: metal-high
clips.caption: Fast aggressive metal: heavily distorted down-tuned rhythm guitars, double kick drums, a shouted harsh male vocal and a screaming guitar lead. Furious and loud.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Iron in the engine, fire in the wire
Every wall around me climbing higher

[Chorus]
Break it down, tear it out
Break it down, hear me shout

clips.name: metal-low
clips.caption: A slow brooding doom-laden rock piece: clean dark arpeggiated guitar, distant heavy chords, a low mournful male vocal. Ominous and spacious.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ash on the water, smoke on the hill
The bells have stopped ringing, the valley is still

clips.name: rock-high-1
clips.caption: A driving anthemic rock song: crunchy electric guitar riff, pounding drums, a strong male lead vocal and a big sing-along chorus. Stadium energy.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Headlights cutting through the county line
Radio is broken but we're doing fine

[Chorus]
Turn it up, we are never going home
Turn it up, let the whole night roll

clips.name: rock-high-2
clips.caption: Jangly upbeat alternative rock with a female lead vocal, chiming guitars, a melodic bass line and tight punchy drums. Bright and restless.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Painted my name on a borrowed guitar
Sold all my records and I bought a used car

[Chorus]
I'm not waiting for the weather to change
I'm not waiting, I'm already on my way

clips.name: rock-low
clips.caption: A mellow soft rock ballad: clean electric guitar arpeggios, gentle drums, warm bass and a tender male vocal. Wistful and slow.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Porch light is on though it's nearly dawn
I kept your sweater since the day you've gone

[Chorus]
Slow, slow, the summer leaves
Slow, slow, and nobody grieves

clips.name: hiphop-high
clips.caption: Hard-hitting boom bap hip hop: punchy kick and snare, deep sub bass, a chopped piano stab loop and a confident rhythmic male rap vocal.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Up before the sun with a pocket full of plans
Notebook, headphones, hammer in my hands
Building every day, brick by brick by brick
Never in a hurry but I never miss a lick

clips.name: hiphop-low
clips.lyrics: [Instrumental]
clips.caption: A laid-back lo-fi hip hop beat: dusty mellow drums, soft electric piano chords, vinyl crackle and a sleepy bass line. Relaxed study music.

clips.name: rnb-high
clips.caption: An upbeat funk and soul groove: slap bass, tight rhythm guitar scratches, a horn section and a powerful joyful female vocal. Dance floor energy.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Friday on my shoulders and a rhythm in my shoes
Everybody's talking but I've got nothing to lose

[Chorus]
Get on up, get on the floor
Get on up, give me some more

clips.name: rnb-low
clips.caption: A smooth slow jam: silky electric piano, soft finger-snap beat, deep warm bass and an intimate breathy female vocal with lush harmonies.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Candle on the table, city turning blue
All the noise is fading when I'm next to you

[Chorus]
Stay a little longer, stay

clips.name: electronic-high
clips.lyrics: [Instrumental]
clips.caption: Driving club techno: four-on-the-floor kick, rolling bass line, sharp hi-hats, a pulsing synth arpeggio that builds and opens up. Hypnotic and energetic.

clips.name: electronic-low
clips.lyrics: [Instrumental]
clips.caption: Dreamy ambient downtempo electronica: slow soft beat, wide warm synth pads, a gentle bell-like melody and deep sub bass. Floating and calm.

clips.name: latin-high
clips.caption: A festive salsa band: congas and timbales, montuno piano, bright trumpets and a lively male vocal with a call-and-response chorus. Party atmosphere.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
La noche está caliente, la luna va a bailar
La gente de mi barrio ya quiere celebrar

[Chorus]
Baila, baila, que suene el tambor
Baila, baila, con todo el corazón

clips.name: latin-low
clips.caption: A romantic slow bolero: nylon-string guitars, soft bongos, upright bass and a warm heartfelt male vocal. Tender and nostalgic.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Bajo la lluvia te vuelvo a recordar
Las calles vacías me quieren hablar

[Chorus]
Despacio, despacio, se va la canción

clips.name: country-high-1
clips.caption: An upbeat honky-tonk country song: twangy telecaster guitar, fiddle, pedal steel, a shuffling train beat and a cheerful male vocal with a drawl.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Mud on the tires and a dog in the back
Two-lane highway and a brown paper sack

[Chorus]
Gonna dance till the neon burns out tonight
Boots on the boards and the fiddle playing right

clips.name: country-high-2
clips.caption: A bright modern country song with a confident female lead vocal, strummed acoustic guitars, banjo rolls, big drums and a catchy chorus.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Mama said the big town would chew me up whole
I packed a suitcase and a pocketful of soul

[Chorus]
Watch me go, watch me shine
Dusty little girl on the Nashville line

clips.name: country-low
clips.caption: A slow country ballad: crying pedal steel guitar, soft acoustic strumming, brushed drums and a lonesome male vocal. Heartbroken and gentle.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Empty chair at the kitchen table
I'd call you up if I was able

[Chorus]
Lonesome is a long, long road

clips.name: folk-high
clips.caption: A stomping folk sing-along: strummed acoustic guitars, mandolin, hand claps, a kick drum on every beat and a group of voices joining the chorus. Warm and joyful.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Bring your brothers and your sisters and a chair
There is room around the fire and a song to share

[Chorus]
Hey ho, the harvest is in
Hey ho, let the dancing begin

clips.name: folk-low
clips.caption: A quiet fingerpicked acoustic folk song with a soft close female vocal and a little harmonica. Intimate, simple and honest.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Paper lanterns on the kitchen door
Snow came early like the year before

[Chorus]
River under ice, keep moving on

clips.name: pop-high-1
clips.caption: A sparkling dance-pop song: punchy drums, bouncing synth bass, bright synth hooks and a catchy female vocal with stacked harmonies in the chorus.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Glitter on my jacket and the city on my phone
Every little light says I'm never alone

[Chorus]
Oh oh oh, we light up the night
Oh oh oh, everything is right

clips.name: pop-high-2
clips.caption: A feel-good mid-tempo pop song with a smooth male vocal, funky clean guitar, claps, warm bass and a whistled hook. Sunny and easygoing.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Windows down and nowhere I have to be
Saturday is spelling out my name for me

[Chorus]
Good day, good day, look at that sky
Good day, good day, we're getting by

clips.name: pop-low
clips.caption: A soft emotional pop ballad: gentle piano, subtle strings, light percussion and a clear vulnerable female vocal. Quiet and bittersweet.
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
I kept the ticket from the very first show
Folded in a book where nobody would know

[Chorus]
If you ever wonder, I remember it all
